title: Momentum Systems
hook: Getting started is the hardest part. Restarting after a break is somehow even harder.
statement: Starting takes the most energy. Once you're moving, momentum does a lot of the work for you.
explainer: Every time you break the streak, you pay the full startup cost again. Keeping it going, even barely, is way cheaper than rebuilding from zero.
sop: Pick one habit or project to build momentum on.
Rate your Previous Action from 1 to 10. Did you show up yesterday?
Rate your Consistency from 1 to 10. How unbroken is the streak?
Define a tiny streak-saving version for busy or low-energy days.
Plan around travel and deadlines before they hit.
equation_example: Previous Action 9, Consistency 8. 9 × 8 = 72 out of 100. Higher means momentum is building and each day starts easier. Lower means the streak is fragile and every restart costs full effort.
question: Write down where your momentum is most fragile, and the tiny version that keeps it alive.
closing_statement: Momentum is easier to protect than to rebuild.
caption:
Principle Nº 158: Momentum Systems

Getting started is the hardest part. Restarting after a break is somehow even harder.

Starting takes the most energy. Once you're moving, momentum does a lot of the work for you.
